page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2ne.3xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 12 dedicated physical cores of the Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The instance is configured with 48.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying entirely on network-attached storage and offering a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates a clear distinction between single-threaded and multi-threaded performance. Single-core execution is relatively weak, with stress-ng and Geekbench single-core scores falling into the bottom 25% and 10% categories respectively. However, the 12 dedicated physical cores deliver average multi-core performance, as demonstrated by stress-ng multi-core and Geekbench multi-core benchmarks. Memory bandwidth remains average for both cached and uncached operations, though Passmark memory scores are positioned in the bottom 25%.

Given the performance profile, the ecs.sn2ne.3xlarge is suited for multi-threaded workloads that can leverage the 12 dedicated cores, such as software compilation, multi-threaded decompression, and moderate database operations. It is less optimal for single-threaded tasks, high-throughput static web serving, or large-scale LLM inference. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the instance offers a balanced resource density for general-purpose computing where dedicated CPU allocation is required without the premium cost of high-frequency or memory-optimized hardware classes.
